prompt: Create an animation sheet of ONLY TWO German field-gray artillery crewmen per frame for this existing side-view pixel-art PaK 38 anti-tank gun. The gun reference establishes viewpoint and size; DO NOT draw the gun itself, any wheels, barrel, base, ground or scenery in the output. The second reference establishes the accepted soldier style: gray uniforms, large gray-green steel helmets, simple pixel faces, dark boots and black outlines. No insignia needed. Exactly 4 COLUMNS and 2 ROWS of equal cells, a pair of crewmen in each cell, transparent background with wide clear gutters. The pair's feet and kneeling knees share a fixed ground baseline; two people separated horizontally with the empty gun mechanism area BETWEEN them. Crew height about two thirds of cell height, whole figures visible. Both crew look LEFT. Left man crouched, hands near shoulder-height empty breech; right man kneels carrying a long brass shell in both hands reaching LEFT. Same kneeling body positions in all first-row frames. ROW 0: four sequential weapon-work poses, (1) calm ready/aim, (2) slight arm and shoulder recoil, (3) loader reaches in with magazine/shell while other man holds controls, (4) return to ready. Feet/head scale and center positions stay fixed; no walking, gun firing flash or large movement. ROW 1: four non-graphic defeat/collapse poses for the same pair: (1) let go and slump, (2) tilt heads and sink onto hands, (3) settle onto ground, (4) hold quiet prone/collapsed figures low. No blood, wounds or injury detail. Clear readable chunky pixel clusters at 60-80 pixels per figure, NOT smooth realistic painting or tiny photorealistic men. Same figures, proportions and exact pair spacing in every cell, distinct gestures, no text/labels/dividers. Output crew layers ONLY; the existing game gun is composited in front separately.
